attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended on 30 September 2026
voiceSummary: Shradha Realty Limited submitted the Fourth Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the National Stock Exchange on November 14, 2026. The report, issued by Brickwork Ratings India Private Limited, covers the utilization of proceeds from a Rights Issue aggregating Rs. 121.50 Crore. The company raised Rs. 121.50 Crore through the allotment of 30,374,088 equity shares at Rs. 40 per share. The Monitoring Agency confirmed no deviation from the objects of the issue. Funds were allocated to investment by way of loan to a wholly owned subsidiary for Rs. 75.00 Crore, working capital requirements for Rs. 16.50 Crore, general corporate purpose for Rs. 29.50 Crore, and issue expenses for Rs. 0.50 Crore. Utilization was verified by V.K. Surana & Co. Chartered Accountants.

attchmntText: Integrated Filling Financial Results as on 30th September, 2026
voiceSummary: Shradha Realty Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was Rs. 428.93 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 660.80 lakhs for the half year. Standalone profit after tax was Rs. 296.27 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 521.81 lakhs for the half year. Basic earnings per share stood at Rs. 0.37 for the quarter and Rs. 0.64 for the half year. The Board approved the sale of Office Block Unit Nos. T1 and T2 for Rs. 4,15,00,000. Active Infrastructures Limited, a subsidiary, approved admission as a partner in Mahalaxmi Zenith LLP with a capital contribution of Rs. 90,000. The meeting was held on 14th November 2026.

attchmntText: Shradha Realty Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: Shradha Realty Limited held its Third Board Meeting on 14th November 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone revenue for the half year was Rs. 660.80 lakhs with a profit before tax of Rs. 674.95 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 0.64. The Board also approved the sale of Office Block Units T1 and T2 in Nagpur to Mr. Inderpreet Singh Tuli and Mrs. Mandeep Kaur Tuli for Rs. 4,15,00,000. Additionally, the Board noted that subsidiary Active Infrastructures Limited approved admission as a partner in Mahalaxmi Zenith LLP with a capital contribution of Rs. 90,000. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified review report on the financial results.

attchmntText: Shradha Realty Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Shradha Realty Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone revenue was 428.93 lakhs for the quarter and 660.80 lakhs for the half year. Standalone profit after tax was 296.27 lakhs for the quarter and 521.81 lakhs for the half year. Basic earnings per share were 0.37 rupees for the quarter and 0.64 rupees for the half year. The board approved the sale of office blocks T1 and T2 for 4,15,00,000 rupees. Active Infrastructures Limited, a subsidiary, approved admission to Mahalaxmi Zenith LLP with a capital contribution of 90,000 rupees representing 90 percent of total capital.
